thread:
jen: opened PR 901 to add a small "Batching & Cost" playbook to the Console observability quickstart. Goals: short rationale, a tiny dashboard snippet showing p50/p95, and SDK examples (Go + JS) that show attaching trace tags for cost attribution. also found a stale crosslink in tracing hooks.

oscar: +1 we need clear guidance on MaxBatchTokens and an example of when to prioritize latency vs cost. keep it short.

matt: can we include an ultra-mini table with recommended defaults: dev: MaxBatchTokens=256, staging=512, prod=1024 and a note about warmup costs?

alina: I can add the Go and JS snippets. will keep them to 6-8 lines each and show trace attach + SetTag("team").

jen: yes. also include a one-sentence explanation of how prefix/KV caching affects p95 for chat workloads.

docs-bot: lint: docs/observability/batching_playbook.md -> broken link https://old.redwood/tracehook -> 404

nora: I'll create a redirect for the tracehook link and replace the stale image used in the playbook.

matt: draft of the tiny dashboard YAML (minimal):
```yaml
widgets:
  - name: latency-overview
    metric: redwood.request.latency.p50
    compare: redwood.request.latency.p95
  - name: cost-estimate
    metric: redwood.request.cost.usd_per_1k
```

oscar: note: older docs used `latency_p50`—we should call out the migration in a single line and link to changelog.

alina: draft Go snippet pushed to branch:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
ctx := client.NewTraceContext("batch-playbook")
ctx.SetTag("team","payments") // used by dashboards for cost attribution
// tip: client.Config.MaxBatchTokens = 1024 // higher -> lower cost per token, higher p95
url, _ := client.Dashboards().Render(ctx, "batching-playbook")
fmt.Println(url)
```

jen: good. add a one-liner explaining tradeoffs (latency vs unit-cost) above the code block.

alina: added JS snippet too:
```js
const c = new Redwood.Client(process.env.REDWOOD_KEY);
const ctx = c.newTrace('batch-playbook');
ctx.setTag('team','payments');
// set c.config.maxBatchTokens = 1024 to favor cost over p95
const res = await c.dashboards.render(ctx, 'batching-playbook');
console.log(res.shareUrl);
```

matt: love it. can we also add a quick note about warm-up: first N requests may be slightly slower as kernels compile. suggest a canary ramp for Prod.

oscar: adding a tiny canary checklist line: 5% traffic for 30m, monitor p95 and error-rate, rollback if errors >0.1%.

ci-bot: queued: docs lint + frontmatter linkcheck + smoke test for images.

nora: redirects created and image replaced; posting canonical URLs in the PR description.

jen: timeline: aim to merge today if CI green. will request reviews after the snippets are final. flag any blocking issues here.

alina: pushing final tweaks now (added the migration note and the tiny defaults table).

matt: I'll add the changelog entry for metric rename and a short line in the Quickstart migration notes.

jen: thanks everyone — once CI is happy I'll do the merge. :shipit:
